crossRefs.note: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be…
Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

translations.web: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
translations.bsb: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
translations.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
translations.asv: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,
